headline: Meghmani Organics updates stock exchanges on new credit rating
hook: New credit rating assigned to Meghmani Organics
summary: Meghmani Organics Limited has formally informed the stock exchanges regarding a new credit rating assigned to the company. The regulatory filing does not disclose the specific rating grade or the rating agency in the headline notice. Indian retail investors tracking the company should check the detailed rating report for implications on borrowing costs.
whats_next: Detailed credit rating report release by the company
why_it_matters: Borrowing costs may shift based on the new rating.

headline: Merck announces receipt of the NCLT Ahmedabad bench amalgamation order
summary: Merck has received the certified copy of the amalgamation order passed by the National Company Law Tribunal (NCLT) Ahmedabad Bench. This order marks a key regulatory milestone in concluding the company's merger process. Shareholders and investors in the listed entity must note the progression of corporate restructuring. The completion of this legal step brings the merger closer to final execution.
whats_next: Filing of the order with the Registrar of Companies
